<module id="float_multi">
    <description>Implements a 32-bit floating point multiplier for IEEE-754 single precision.</description>
    
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="rst">Reset signal for synchronous operation.</input>
        
        <input id="a" width_description="[31:0]">First operand in IEEE-754 format.</input>
        <input id="b" width_description="[31:0]">Second operand in IEEE-754 format.</input>
        
        <output id="z" width_description="[31:0]">Result of the multiplication in IEEE-754 format.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="ZERO">IEEE 754 representation of zero.</parameter>
        <parameter id="INFINITY">IEEE 754 representation of infinity.</parameter>
        <parameter id="NAN">IEEE 754 representation of Not-a-Number.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    
    <implementation>
        // Sequential logic for managing internal states and outputs
        sequential_block begin : float_multiplier_seq
        
            // Define registers for internal signals
            reg [2:0] counter;
            reg [23:0] a_mantissa, b_mantissa, z_mantissa;
            reg [9:0] a_exponent, b_exponent, z_exponent;
            reg a_sign, b_sign, z_sign;
            
            // Register to hold the intermediate product of mantissas
            reg [49:0] product;
            // Rounding bits for normalization process
            reg guard_bit, round_bit, sticky;
            // Output register
            reg [31:0] z_reg;
            
            // Synchronous block triggered on rising edge of the clock
            @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
            
                // Check for asynchronous reset condition
                if(rst == 1'b1) begin
                    
                    // Initialize the counter to zero on reset
                    counter <= 3'b0;
                    
                    // Reset the output register to zero
                    z_reg <= 32'h0;
                
                end else begin
                
                    case(counter)
                        // Extract mantissa, exponent, and sign bits from input 'a' during the first cycle
                        3'd0: begin
                            a_mantissa[22:0] <= a[22:0];
                            a_exponent[9:0] <= a[30:23] - 127; // Subtract bias value of 127
                            a_sign <= a[31]; // Assign sign bit of 'a'
                            
                            // Normalize mantissa by adding hidden bit if necessary
                            if(a_exponent[9]) begin
                                a_mantissa[23] <= 1'b1;
                            end else begin
                                a_mantissa[23] <= 1'b0;
                            end
                        end
                        
                        // Extract mantissa, exponent, and sign bits from input 'b' during the second cycle
                        3'd1: begin
                            b_mantissa[22:0] <= b[22:0];
                            b_exponent[9:0] <= b[30:23] - 127; // Subtract bias value of 127
                            b_sign <= b[31]; // Assign sign bit of 'b'
                            
                            // Normalize mantissa by adding hidden bit if necessary
                            if(b_exponent[9]) begin
                                b_mantissa[23] <= 1'b1;
                            end else begin
                                b_mantissa[23] <= 1'b0;
                            end
                        end
                        
                        // Perform multiplication of mantissas during the third cycle
                        3'd2: begin
                            product[49:0] <= {1'b0,a_mantissa} * {1'b0,b_mantissa}; // Multiply mantissas
                            z_sign <= a_sign ^ b_sign; // XOR the sign bits of 'a' and 'b'
                            z_exponent[9:0] <= a_exponent + b_exponent + 127; // Add biased exponents and subtract bias value
                        end
                        
                        // Round the result during the fourth cycle
                        3'd3: begin
                            // Determine rounding bits for normalization
                            guard_bit <= product[24];
                            round_bit <= product[23];
                            sticky <= |product[22:0]; // OR reduction operator to determine if any bits after guard and round bits are non-zero
                            
                            // Calculate new exponent and adjust mantissa based on rounding bits
                            if(guard_bit && ((round_bit || sticky || product[24]))) begin
                                product[49:25] <= product[49:25] + 1'b1;
                            end
                            // Check for overflow in exponent
                            if(product[49]) begin
                                z_exponent <= z_exponent + 1'b1;
                                product[49:25] <= product[49:25] >> 1;
                            end
                        end
                        
                        // Generate final output during the fifth cycle
                        3'd4: begin
                            // Assign normalized mantissa to output
                            z_mantissa <= product[48:25];
                            
                            // Handle special cases such as NaN and Infinity
                            if((a_exponent == 128 && a_mantissa != 0) || (b_exponent == 128 && b_mantissa != 0)) begin
                                z_reg <= NAN;
                            end else if(z_exponent >= 127) begin
                                z_reg <= INFINITY;
                            end else begin
                                z_reg[31] <= z_sign; // Assign sign bit of output
                                z_reg[30:23] <= z_exponent[7:0] + 127; // Add bias value back to exponent
                                z_reg[22:0] <= z_mantissa[22:0]; // Assign mantissa to output
                            end
                        end
                    endcase
                    
                    // Increment the counter for the next cycle
                    counter <= counter + 1;
                    
                end
            end
        end
        
        // Assign the final output to the port 'z'
        assign z = z_reg;
    </implementation>
</module>
